article.title: Everyday phone call phrases
article.description: Answering: 'Hello, this is [name] speaking.' Asking to hold: 'Could you hold on a second?' Ending: 'Thanks for calling, talk soon!' Common mistake: 'I am [name]' on the phone sounds unnatural in English — 'This is [name]' is the standard phone convention.
article.content: Answering: 'Hello, this is [name] speaking.' Asking to hold: 'Could you hold on a second?' Ending: 'Thanks for calling, talk soon!' Common mistake: 'I am [name]' on the phone sounds unnatural in English — 'This is [name]' is the standard phone convention.

generated.caption:
Ever said "I am [name]" on the phone and felt it wasn't quite right? 📞 It sounds unnatural! The standard is "Hello, this is [name] speaking." Need to pause? Say "Could you hold on a second?" And to finish up, "Thanks for calling, talk soon!" Master these to sound confident.

Save this for your next call! Follow @TheEnglishVault for daily English lessons.
generated.script: Phone uthate hi, aap bhi "I am [name]" bolte ho kya? Dekho, normally jab hum khud ko introduce karte hain, toh "I am Prerna" bolte hain. But phone pe "I am Prerna" sunne mein thoda unnatural lagta hai. Wahaan par standard convention hai "This is Prerna speaking." Ya simply "Hello, this is Prerna." Samjhe? Aur agar kisi ko hold pe rakhna hai, toh bolo "Could you hold on a second?" Aur call end karte time, "Thanks for calling, talk soon!" bol sakte ho. Toh ab se jab bhi phone uthaoge, apna naam batane ke liye bolo, "Hello, this is Prerna speaking." Sunne mein bhi professional aur natural lagega. Pata tha yeh difference? Comment karke batao! Aur aise hi English tips ke liye The English Vault ko follow karna mat bhoolna!

slides.headlineRest: — The Natural Way to Answer Calls
slides.body: When answering the phone, the standard and most natural way to introduce yourself in English is to say, 'Hello, this is [name] speaking.' It's a common mistake for English learners to say 'I am [name]' on the phone, but this sounds unnatural to native speakers. Always opt for 'This is [name]' as the conventional phone introduction. Other useful phrases include 'Could you hold on a second?' for asking someone to wait briefly, and 'Thanks for calling, talk soon!' to end the conversation politely.
slides.hindiSummary: फोन कॉल पर अपना परिचय देते समय 'मैं [नाम] हूँ' के बजाय 'यह [नाम] है' कहना अधिक स्वाभाविक लगता है।
